content.text: Collection of blood inside the anterior chamber of the eye
(the space between the cornea and the iris); blood may cover most or all of iris/pupil, blocking vision partially or completely; usually
*blood might not be visible if hyphema is small
: idiopathic intracranial HTN, space-occupying lesion (cerebral tumor, abscess), ⇡ CSF production, cerebral edema, severe HTN (grade IV)
swollen optic disc w/ blurred margins
: MRI/CT (r/o mass effect) ⇢ LP (⇡ CSF pressure)
MC cause of permanent legal blindness & vision loss in older adults (esp. >75)
Wet occurs more rapidly & is more severe
– small, round, yellow-white spots on the outer retina (represent local deposits of extracellular material)
that can cause retinal hemorrhaging & scarring
) may slow progression but do not reverse changes
*amsler grid at home to monitor stability
